![Virtual conference screen: building layout with rooms and attendee names, presenters shown, AVI-SPL & Microsoft Teams logos at top.](https://avispl.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/MSTeams-podcast-preview-e1737717536611.jpg)

Returning to the office may give employees pause. Some remember the hour-long drive times. Others might wonder, “What if I can’t find a workstation or meeting space that meets my needs?” In addition to employee concerns, IT must now ensure they have space to accommodate varying schedules and shifts in office attendance.

The good news?  Tools like Microsoft Places can help you achieve these goals.

And AVI-SPL is ready to help you onboard Places. We’re a global AV/UC integrator in the **[Microsoft Places partner ecosystem.](https://avispl.com/blog/avi-spl-joins-inaugural-microsoft-places-partner-ecosystem/)** We’re honored to have been involved since before it launched into Public Preview.

## You can learn more about Places now by watching our podcast below.

AVI-SPL’s Ron Wolfe, Vice President, Global Microsoft Practice, explores the employee and workplace benefits of Microsoft Places in this episode of The Collaboration Space podcast. He covers:

- Return to work mandates
- How Microsoft Places supports flexible work and modernizes offices with intuitive tech
- AVI-SPL’s alignment with the Microsoft Places launch
- How Places can help you understand employee in-office experiences and compare planned vs. actual employee meeting or workstation use
- Top customer benefits including workplace optimization, available analytics, and Microsoft standardization

**Watch the podcast for more details, then [contact us](https://avispl.com/contact-us/) to get started.**
